correctness.rationale: Abrams' sufficient-subdivision condition is satisfied for two particles: distinct degree-3 vertices are separated by at least one edge and every nontrivial circuit has girth six. The unordered model has 91 vertex pairs, 252 edge-stationary cells, and 168 disjoint-edge squares; signed boundaries square to zero. Connectedness gives rank∂1=90; a mod-3 rank∂2=154 bounds dim_Q H1≤8, whereas all 28 six-cycle edge vectors span graph H1 dimension eight and lift through the stationary-particle map, forcing equivariant H1(B2)≅H1(H;Q) and rank_Q∂2=154. Euler chi 7 forces H2 dimension14. Lefschetz on the signed cubical chains computes χ_H2(g)=t0−t1+t2−1+χ_graphcycle(g) for every g. I independently built the Fano incidence graph and 336 collineations/polarities and recomputed the complete eight-row table with counts (1,21,56,42,48,28,56,84) and H1/H2 traces (8,14),(0,−2),(−1,−1),(0,2),(1,0),(−2,−2),(1,1),(0,0); it agrees exactly. Character norms/inner products imply two distinct norm-one irreducible characters; both average zero. The pinned script additionally contains mod-101 top-kernel check. No integral torsion or quotient homotopy conclusion is drawn.
